caption: The drawing depicts a single oil lamp placed centrally on a plain, light beige background. The lamp consists of three main parts: a clear glass chimney at the top with delicate, detailed etched floral and scrollwork designs; a brass or gold-colored metal burner in the middle, featuring a wick adjustment knob; and a rounded, ornate base made of dark blue glass with embossed floral and leaf patterns. The lamp is upright and symmetrical, with the blue glass base providing contrast to the transparent upper chimney. There is a small signature or marking near the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Blue Glass Lamp
